review.assessment: This change introduces a stub implementation of `compare_versions` that unconditionally returns `Ordering::Equal`, ignoring both input strings and completely omitting the required numerical comparison logic. It causes any test case involving different versions to fail, as confirmed by the host measurement where `newer_patch_is_greater` reported an assertion mismatch. No parsing, component iteration, or trailing-zero padding is implemented to satisfy the task specification.

findings.defect: Unconditional equality return instead of numerical version comparison
findings.expected: `Ordering::Greater` (or correct `Ordering` based on numeric component evaluation)
